english.meaning: measure word for films, plays and TV dramas
english.note: 一齣戲 is a film; 一齣劇 is a drama.

exampleSentences.english: I mean, you don’t watch movies often, so whenever you watch one, you think it’s great.
exampleSentences.traditional: 即係你唔係成日睇呢，睇一齣戲呢，就覺得佢好正。
